# Canary — world risk status as_of 2026-11-28T17:52Z · next run ~23:40 UK · stale after 2026-11-29T07:52Z (36h for daily-tier signals) Assessed by an AI model (Anthropic Claude) against published rubrics; attention levels, not forecasts or advice. CC BY 4.0 · https://canary.danleech.com Basis: 27 measured from open data, 9 follow a published figure, 53 are AI judgements from news reports (weigh these with more caution). Known limitations: https://canary.danleech.com/methodology#known-limits
World State 40/100 (Strained) · 14 Alert · 46 Watch · 29 Normal Headline: Conflicts in Ukraine, the Gulf and Yemen, Sudan's war and DR Congo's Ebola epidemic stay at Alert; CO₂ growth crosses its Alert line as record global heat and a very strong El Niño persist.
## Situations (7 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, stable]: Italy says on 28 Nov a Kuwaiti inquiry found an Iranian-made drone killed two Italians on 26 Nov; US disables a blockade runner on 26 Nov. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, eu-gas, chokepoints, freight, uk-energy-cap; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, oil, fertiliser, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, stable]: Russia launched 162 drones overnight to 28 Nov; seven killed in a 27 Nov strike on Nizhyn; a Russian drone entered Polish airspace on 23 Nov. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI +2.46 for Aug–Oct; global temperature 2.21°C above pre-industrial on 22 Nov, a record for the date; CO₂ growth 3.24 ppm a year. → alert: enso, global-temp, co2; watch: drought, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: WHO counts 11,613 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,678 deaths in DR Congo to 17 Nov; Kenya and Nigeria report imported cases. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: UN rights office said on 19 Nov drones killed over 1,630 civilians from January to October; UN warns of famine risk in Darfur and Kordofan. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - France: debt stress and protests [WATCH, stable]: French 10-year yield 4.74% on 26 Nov after a 24-year high in October; protest turnout fell to 82,500 on 21 Nov. → watch: sovereign-debt, civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: US CPI about 4.1% in Oct and UK CPI 3.6%; markets weigh a large Fed rise on 8–9 Dec; Ofgem cap up 26% from 1 Jan. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility, gilts; normal: em-stress
## Other Alerts - Cholera & mosquito-borne [cholera-dengue] stable, AI-judged: WHO counts over 3,000 cholera deaths in 2026, including about 1,800 in DR Congo, mostly in the conflict-hit east - UK terrorism threat level [uk-threat-level] stable, AI-judged: UK national terrorism threat level is Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 28 Nov
## Changed in last 24h - Atmospheric CO₂ [co2]: WATCH→ALERT — CO₂ 430.07 ppm at Mauna Loa in the week of 22 Nov, up 3.24 ppm on a year, above the 3.0 ppm Alert line (2026-11-28T17:52Z) - Internet & cloud outages [outages]: NORMAL→WATCH — Lloyds, Halifax and Bank of Scotland apps down for hours on 27 Nov; Allstate's site and app down since 23 Nov (2026-11-28T05:54Z) - Dollar funding stress [funding-stress]: NORMAL→WATCH — Fed overnight repo operations jump to $22.8bn in the latest reading to 27 Nov, above the $15bn Watch line (2026-11-27T23:43Z)
## Emerging (outside the catalogue; provisional) - Cuba humanitarian strain under US fuel blockade [WATCH]: WHO chief Tedros urged the US on 24–25 Nov to lift its fuel blockade on Cuba; outages of over 20 hours a day reported on 27 Nov
## Watch (ids; detail at /s/{id}.md) equity-stress, bond-volatility, gold, crypto, funding-stress, private-credit, us-inflation, china-economy, central-banks, sovereign-debt, oil, food-prices, critical-minerals, fertiliser, nuclear-plants, us-china, russia-nato, iran-nuclear, trade-war, sanctions, hybrid-threats, drc-east, sahel, myanmar, india-pakistan, nuclear-risk, other-conflicts, drought, sea-ice, who-emergencies, mpox, measles, respiratory, medicine-shortages, cyber, outages, cables-gnss, semiconductors, ai-governance, exploited-vulns, famine, civil-unrest, aid-funding, uk-rates, gilts, nhs-pressure
## Sentiment (measured from open data; context only, never changes a status) News tone vs own past 6 months (GDELT, 7 days to 2026-11-27; number = % of past weeks less negative): gloomier: tech (89); brighter: conflict (21), energy (12), disasters (2), health (8); typical: economy, trade, climate, migration Consumer confidence (OECD, long-run avg 100): OECD 98.0 (2026-10), GBR 98.9 (2026-10), USA 96.0 (2026-10), EA20 97.9 (2026-10), JPN 98.4 (2026-10), CHN 95.4 (2026-09), IND 100.0 (2026-09) Uncertainty: US policy uncertainty 0.8× its 1-year median · Geopolitical risk in the news 1.0× its 1-year median · Market fear (VIX) higher than 88% of the past year
